caption: The drawing depicts a metal horse bit with attached decorative and functional components. The central object is a metallic, likely silver or steel, bit with two curved shanks, each featuring ornate etched and engraved motifs. The left shank includes a circular concho with a floral design, while both shanks have chains connecting their lower portions. The mouthpiece is a straight bar, and above it, two brown leather straps or cords are looped and attached to the upper components of the bit. The metal surfaces display a mix of smooth and textured areas, with attached round, button-like decorations. Several small metal loops and a hook are visible at the ends of the bit, alongside linked metal chains and attachments. The entire object is rendered centrally on a plain, off-white background, with the artist’s name, “Edward T. Jewett,” printed in small letters below the image.
title: Bit
